video_title: This Wasn’t Just Another Wade Family Vacation

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union on their work-life balance
quotes.excerpt: I would have a much different work-life balance.

text_blocks.speaker: Dwyane Wade
text_blocks.text: This is the three-month break from the beginning of the year. Parents working, doing all the parent things, and then now we get the break too.

text_blocks.speaker: Gabrielle Union
text_blocks.text: I mean listen, because I remember when we were shooting 'The Perfect Find' and DMX was like, 'It's spring break.' And I'm like, 'Oh like your kids?' And he's like, 'No.' He had it. He figured he understood. We were in the middle of production and he took one. He took a nice extended one. I would have a much different work-life balance.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade reflects on his health and kidney surgery
quotes.excerpt: At 44 years old, I shouldn't have had cancer surgery already.
quotes.quote: At 44 years old, I shouldn't have had cancer surgery already. I'm about the numbers, but it's scary in you. I started living a little different life, a little freer. I smile more, and I always smile. I laugh more. I appreciate more. I'm thankful. I feel better, feel younger. Well, not that left knee, but you know what I mean.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade reflects on his 2003 Final Four performance
quotes.excerpt: One of the best basketball games I've ever played in my life was on March 29th.
quotes.quote: I never hit five pars in a row. My max is four and I was by myself at my local golf course. Five pars in a row with a birdie before that. Man, I love this place. This place is good to me. Probably the best round of golf I've played in my life consistently is today, March 29th. You know why? One of the best basketball games I've ever played in my life was on March 29th. It was 23 years ago, it was 2003, in the Final Four, triple-double.
